Design choice, stated against the brief's wording 'only in the fix run': holding every support module in the first task run regressed the shape where a task adds a helper/fixture to an existing support module and its red is the implementation's (sr226 goes red under that mutation, m3) - e.g. a pytest conftest fixture would turn an assertion red into a fixture-not-found error; the re-run mirrors the existing task-held re-run for inline pulled-in code. (2) printed labels now come from printed_run(): the fix run, else the --introduces second run, else the task's own run under its tag; the payload gains printedFrom (which run) and supportAtHead (what was held). (3) support_clause() rides every basis and the not-red note when a module was held; the text output prints the held modules.
